name: kw_archive_writer
reason: Open decision 3, settled by the user: the KWA archive format is no longer needed. It was the only VXL user left in kwiver's sprokit processes, writing through VXL's vsl binary serialisation, so keeping it would have meant reproducing that format byte for byte. configs/pipelines/filter_to_kwa.pipe existed only to write one and is deleted; the five indexing and query pipelines that also wrote an archive alongside their real work keep working without it.

name: ffmpeg_clip
reason: arrows/ffmpeg's clip reader. No shipped pipeline or config selects it, and no VIAME tool asks for it by name; it goes with the arrow rather than being reimplemented on PyAV. The plain ffmpeg reader it wraps is now python and keeps its name.

name: ffmpeg
reason: arrows/ffmpeg's still-image reader, which decoded a single frame through libavcodec. No shipped pipeline or config selects it; image reading is core, ocv and vxl, all of which remain.

name: apply_child_klv
reason: arrows/klv. No shipped pipeline, config or VIAME tool names it; it is the only reason the closure reaches arrows/klv, which lite-removals.md section 5 and the phase 5 sanity list both say must not be imported. KLV is full motion video metadata, which VIAME does not read or write.

name: update_klv
reason: arrows/klv, as apply_child_klv above.

name: derive_corner_points
reason: arrows/geocalc. No shipped pipeline, config or VIAME tool names it; it derives image corner geo-coordinates from KLV metadata, which VIAME does not read. It is the only reason the closure reaches arrows/geocalc.

name: cuda
reason: arrows/cuda. No shipped pipeline, config or VIAME tool names it, and none of the depth or reconstruction configs select it; it is the only reason the closure reaches arrows/cuda. VIAME's own CUDA use is through pytorch, not this.

name: template
reason: sprokit/processes/examples/process_template, which is kwiver's worked example of how to write a process. No shipped pipeline uses it, and it is the only reason the closure reaches sprokit/processes/examples, which is not code to import.

name: file_transport_send
reason: sprokit/processes/transport, which moves serialized data between pipelines over files or zmq. No shipped pipeline uses it, its zmq siblings are not even registered in this build, and serialization went with arrows/serialize. It is the only reason the closure reaches sprokit/processes/transport.
